facts.text: QuadrotorEnvironment is a Gym environment that simulates a quadrotor; it is not a hardware interface
The action space is Box(-1, 1, (4,), dtype float32): four continuous command values in [-1, 1]
step() returns (observation, reward, done, {}) and done is delayed_model.time >= max_time
The max_time constructor default is 10 seconds and the controller_period default is 0.01 seconds
The default initial state parameters are box_side_length 2, velocity 1 and angular_velocity 1

random_state draws the position uniformly from [-box_side_length, box_side_length], the velocity and angular velocity uniformly from their bounds, a random rotation, and sets all four propeller speeds to the hovering speed
QuadrotorEnvironment.step computes the reward from the current state before advancing the model when reward_base is 'current_state' (the default)
The SPRWrappedQuadrotorEnvironment is a second Gym wrapper around the same environment that may replace a value with a ('randomize', low, high) triple on each reset

QuadrotorModel defaults: gravity 9.80665 m/s^2, mass 1.43805 kg, moments of inertia (0.01467, 0.01441, 0.02441), propeller half side length 0.16 m, thrust coefficient 1.018841e-5, propeller inertia coefficient 6.32180911740998e-09 and drag coefficient 4.82e-8
The hovering speed is sqrt((mass * gravity / thrust coefficient) / 4)
QuadrotorModel is an explicit model that does not rely on euler or RK-4 integration
The mixer matrix M maps the squared propeller speeds to three moments and the collective thrust
The next propeller speed follows next_prop_rate = x.propeller_speed - (ip ** h - 1) * (u - x.propeller_speed)
next_state computes the next position, velocity, rotation and angular velocity for an explicit step of h seconds
PropellerSpeedMapping defaults: relative_min_speed 0, relative_max_speed 3, an infinite relative propeller acceleration bound, clip acceleration constraint and direct output control
In direct output mode the action element a sets the relative target speed to (a + 1) / 2 * (relative_max_speed - relative_min_speed) + relative_min_speed
ModelDelayWrapper defaults: delay_scale 1, controller_period 0.01 seconds and no observation, action or controller delay or jitter
ModelDelayWrapper.step advances the simulated time by the sampled controller period
StateClippingWrapper defaults clip velocity to [-5, 5] and angular velocity to [-20, 20] and leave the position unbounded
ToObservationMap defaults scale position by 0.5, velocity by 0.5 and angular velocity by 0.15, set the propeller speed, dt and observation-age scales to 0, and observe the rotation
The rotmat_global rotation observation mode returns the rotation matrix flattened row-major
A zero scale removes that state component from the observation
The observation concatenates the observed position, velocity, rotation and angular velocity, then the optional propeller speed, dt and observation age
NoisedStateMap defaults every noise argument to None, so the default observation has no added noise

RewardFunction defaults: reward_scale 0.00076, position weights 9.5 horizontal and 2.2 vertical, velocity 0.9/1.5, rotation 2/2, angular velocity 2/2, propeller speed deviation 1 and propeller acceleration 1
The default reward applies inverted huber scaling to the state terms, sums the propeller speed deviation and acceleration terms, and returns the negative scaled sum

determinism.notes: This package's fake reseeds its Python random generator from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and is deterministic from there; the upstream QuadrotorEnvironment.reset has no seed argument (quadrotor_environment.py:196-197) and draws its initial state from numpy's global generator (quadrotor_environment.py:190-193), so the seeded claim covers the fake backend that is actually served, not an unrun upstream path

gaps: rigid-body quadrotor dynamics only: no contacts, no collision geometry and no aerodynamic model beyond the quadratic propeller thrust and drag coefficients of quadrotor_model.py:65-74
the default configuration has no observation noise, delay or jitter (noise_model.py:24-29, model_delay_wrapper.py:16-23); the fake models the zero-noise, zero-delay defaults only

the fake re-implements the dynamics, the default observation map and the default reward in pure Python floats with Python's random generator; it was never compared with the upstream environment (numpy and numpy-quaternion are not installed where the gate runs), so trajectories can differ from upstream's numpy float64 results and numpy random stream
no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0, one tick advances simulated time by timestep_ms (one controller period of 0.01 s) only
no physical device is modelled and the model was never validated against one
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
